column1: # K-Line Dash: VW Group (VW, Audi, Seat, Cupra, Skoda) manufacturer-specific trouble code meanings
#   - description: our own short wording of the VW Group meaning of a P1xxx code.
#   - note: a short first check, only where sources widely agree; empty otherwise.
# Curated selection, not an import. A code is listed only if at least two independent publications agree
# on its meaning; codes where sources disagree were left out. Per-code sources: docs/research/dtc-sources-vag-honda.md
# Sources (publications, not mirrors of each other):
#   RT  Ross-Tech wiki, one page per fault code: https://wiki.ross-tech.com/wiki/index.php/Category:Fault_Codes
#   VH  VAG number / hex / P-code list (mirrors of the same list count once): https://www.vag-hub.com/vw-audi-seat-skoda-dtc/
#   TC  troublecodes.net, entries labelled Audi/Volkswagen: https://www.troublecodes.net/p1codes/
#   CW  carwiki.de, one page per code: https://carwiki.de/obd-code-p1136-vw-audi (same pattern for other codes)
# Meanings can vary by engine control unit generation; treat them as the usual meaning, not a diagnosis.
